looks.description: A chunky tortoiseshell Persian cat with a tail.
looks.change: Initial appearance

looks.description: A chunky tortoiseshell Persian cat with a fuzzy head and a long tail. She is wearing a small, jeweled, cat-sized crown that glitters with smoky, dark gems and a deep purple stone, along with a little bell and a silver butterfly collar charm.
looks.change: Wears a small jeweled crown, bell and butterfly collar charm.

looks.description: A chunky tortoiseshell Persian cat with a fuzzy head and a long tail. She is wearing a small, jeweled tiara on her head, a little bell, and a collar charm that is a little silver butterfly. A gold-colored mark is on her back over her right shoulder blade, and silver-scale armor is draped over the back half of her body like a skirt with a tail slot, not covering her stomach.
looks.change: Gold mark on back and silver-scale armor skirt added.

looks.description: A cat, wearing a tiara and backside armor, along with a collar with a charm. An Enchanted Anklet of the Fallen Oak sits around her rear left ankle, hidden within her fur.
looks.change: Enchanted anklet added on rear left ankle.

looks.description: A small cat, wearing a purple tiara and backside armor, along with a collar with a charm. An Enchanted Anklet of the Fallen Oak sits around her rear left ankle, hidden within her fur. Her fur is soft. She is riddled with long black spikes like a pin cushion.
looks.change: Tiara is purple; body riddled with long black spikes (this scene only).

looks.description: A small Persian cat with large eyes, wearing a purple crown, backside armor, and a collar with a charm. An Enchanted Anklet of the Fallen Oak, a small magical anklet with three little beads, sits around her rear leg, hidden within her fur. A crupper hangs like a skirt across her backside.
looks.change: Spikes gone; large eyes, purple crown, crupper skirt, beaded anklet.

looks.description: A cat wearing a tiara topped with white jewels.
looks.change: New tiara topped with white jewels.

looks.description: A cat wearing a tiara topped with white jewels, and wearing large, round sunglasses that make her look like a bug, special high-fashion goggles magically affixed to her face; the frames have no arms, and her nose is too squished to hold ordinary frames anyway.
looks.change: Large round bug-like sunglasses added.

looks.description: A cat wearing a tiara topped with white jewels and large, round bug-like sunglasses magically affixed to her face. She is small in stature and wears a pink feather boa around her neck. She is soaked in dripping, steaming guts, with a severed hand clutched tight around her tail.
looks.change: Pink feather boa, soaked in guts, severed hand on tail (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat with bright yellow eyes.
looks.change: Yellow eye color established.

looks.description: A cat with bright yellow eyes, her long hair flowing around her underwater like a sea anemone. She has just been pierced through the stomach by a shard of glass.
looks.change: Underwater hair flow and glass shard through stomach (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat with a tiara and yellow eyes. Her skin is smoldering and her hair is singed; her fur is covered in soot, blackened by the heat.
looks.change: Smoldering skin, singed hair, soot-blackened fur (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat with clean, groomed fur, wearing sunglasses.
looks.change: Clean and groomed, sunglasses on.

looks.description: A cat wearing a collar with an enchanted charm with a plain turquoise gem. She wears an obsidian bracelet on her front right leg, a new silver bracelet with little purple gems on her left front leg, a fallen oak anklet on one back leg and a +2 dexterity anklet on the other back leg, so all four legs have bracelets or anklets.
looks.change: Bracelets and anklets on all four legs.

looks.description: A cat wearing a glittering tiara and a collar with an enchanted charm with a plain turquoise gem. She wears an obsidian bracelet on her front right leg, a silver bracelet with little purple gems on her left front leg, a fallen oak anklet on one back leg and a +2 dexterity anklet on the other back leg.
looks.change: Glittering tiara added.

looks.description: A cat with her belly completely covered in fur and with eight nipples, wearing a gleaming tiara, a little headset microphone, sunglasses, and a collar with an enchanted charm with a plain turquoise gem. She wears an obsidian bracelet on her front right leg, a silver bracelet with little purple gems on her left front leg, a fallen oak anklet on one back leg and a +2 dexterity anklet on the other back leg.
looks.change: Headset microphone and sunglasses added.

looks.description: A cat matted down with gore, her head bloody and matted and her fur sticky with blood. She wears a little fake headset microphone and a collar with an enchanted charm with a plain turquoise gem, an obsidian bracelet on her front right leg, a silver bracelet with little purple gems on her left front leg, a fallen oak anklet on one back leg and a +2 dexterity anklet on the other back leg.
looks.change: Matted with gore and blood (this scene only).

looks.description: A small cat with a red beret on her head and a white tiara.
looks.change: Red beret and white tiara.

looks.description: A small cat with a fuzzy face, a tail and paws. She wears a simple silver-colored tiara with an installed citrine jewel, an enchanted headset microphone, and sunglasses, and has a nipple ring and patches of yellow-orange fur.
looks.change: Silver citrine tiara; nipple ring and yellow-orange fur patches.

looks.description: A cat, larger than usual after taking a size-up potion, with a fuzzy face, a tail and paws. She wears a silver citrine tiara, an enchanted headset microphone, and sunglasses, and has a nipple ring and patches of yellow-orange fur. Her lower mouth trembles when she is really upset.
looks.change: Larger after a size-up potion (this scene only).

looks.description: A small cat with a fuzzy face, a tail and paws. She wears a white sailor hat (a Dixie cup) sitting cock-eyed on her head, along with sunglasses and an enchanted headset microphone, and has a nipple ring and patches of yellow-orange fur. Her lower mouth trembles when she is really upset.
looks.change: White sailor hat on her head (this scene only).

looks.description: A small cat with a fuzzy face, a tail and paws. She wears sunglasses and an enchanted headset microphone, has a nipple ring and patches of yellow-orange fur, and is completely covered in tinsel.
looks.change: Completely covered in tinsel (this scene only).

looks.description: A small cat with a fuzzy face, a tail and paws. She wears a dragonfly tiara, sunglasses and an enchanted headset microphone, and has a nipple ring and patches of yellow-orange fur, with a small opalescent longhorn-cow pin on her neck collar.
looks.change: Dragonfly tiara and longhorn-cow collar pin.

looks.description: A cat wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat and a cat-sized ghillie suit made of long shredded bits of color-changing fabric that blends into the background.
looks.change: Booney hat and ghillie suit added.

looks.description: A cat wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat, a cat-sized ghillie suit of long shredded color-changing fabric that blends into the background, a cat-sized green and black tartan kilt, sunglasses, and a dainty tiara of about a hundred tiny multicolored jewels on her head. A resized cloak with a cerulean lining sits over her shoulders, ridiculously short on her.
looks.change: Kilt, short cerulean-lined cloak, sunglasses and jeweled tiara added.

looks.description: A cat with a flat face, covered in mud and blood, wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat, a cat-sized ghillie suit of long shredded color-changing fabric, a cat-sized green and black tartan kilt, sunglasses, and a dainty tiara of about a hundred tiny multicolored jewels. A short cloak with a cerulean lining sits over her shoulders, and a bubble surrounds her head as ear protection.
looks.change: Flat face; mud, blood and head bubble (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat with a flat face, wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat, a cat-sized ghillie suit of long shredded color-changing fabric, a cat-sized green and black tartan kilt, a short cloak with a cerulean lining, a glittering multicolored jeweled tiara, sunglasses and a headset. She sits regally in a howda mounted on a rhinoceros.
looks.change: Sits in a howda on a rhinoceros (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat with a flat face, wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat, a cat-sized ghillie suit of long shredded color-changing fabric, a cat-sized green and black tartan kilt, a short cloak with a cerulean lining, sunglasses, a headset, and a multicolored jeweled tiara. Her eyes look hollow, as if focused far away.
looks.change: Hollow, far-away eyes (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat with a flat face, wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat, a cat-sized green and black tartan kilt, a short cloak with a cerulean lining, sunglasses, a headset, and a multicolored jeweled tiara. A small, round bald patch is shaved on her right flank, and a line art tattoo of a dog sits on her mottled skin.
looks.change: Bald patch and dog tattoo appear; no ghillie suit.

looks.description: A cat with a flat face, wearing a beige, extra floppy booney hat, a cat-sized green and black tartan kilt, a short cloak with a cerulean lining, a lovely shawl, new knee pads, sunglasses, a headset, and a multicolored jeweled tiara. A small, round bald patch is shaved on her right flank, and a line art tattoo of a dog sits on her mottled skin. A quadrapad weapon mount on her back holds a large repeating crossbow, bigger than she is.
looks.change: Shawl, knee pads and back-mounted crossbow (this scene only).

looks.description: A long-haired cat with an annoying flat face. She is blood-soaked and wild-eyed, with red ash splattered over her fur, and she wears a glittering tiara.
looks.change: Blood-soaked with red ash on fur (this scene only).

looks.description: A long-haired cat with an annoying flat face. She wears an Egyptian-style beaded headdress with red, yellow and orange beads cascading down either side of her face, matching her fur. She wears a chainmail crupper over a shaved patch of skin bearing a tattoo of a dog licking itself. The four front claws on her right paw are covered with red claw caps.
looks.change: Egyptian beaded headdress, chainmail crupper, red claw caps (this scene only).

looks.description: A cat, grown huge and much bigger than a man, with an annoying flat face. She wears an Egyptian-style beaded headdress with red, yellow and orange beads cascading down either side of her face, matching her fur. She wears a chainmail crupper over a shaved patch of skin bearing a tattoo of a dog licking itself. She also wears a cheap green and yellow trucker hat. A weapon mount is formed on her back along with a crossbow. She sits secured in a passenger seat, held in place by straps that tighten around her. She wears knee pads, a headset microphone and sunglasses.
looks.change: Huge size, trucker hat, back weapon mount, strapped into a seat (this scene only).
